statement: The inspected xpad wireless path observes a headset status bit but does not instantiate keyboard, pointer, headset audio or battery power-supply companions. A separate pinned USB Host Shield host implementation queries battery status; this does not establish a Linux xpad battery surface or the physical device's complete capabilities.

applicability.scope: xpad.c 987-1024, 1924-2036; XBOXRECV.cpp 537-556; negative limited to inspected consumers
